description: Line items within an order. One row per product per order. Use this table to compute per-product revenue, quantity sold, and to join products with orders.
use_cases: Finding which products appear most in orders

columns.item_id: Primary key — unique identifier for each line item (INTEGER or UUID)
columns.order_id: Foreign key linking to orders.order_id (INTEGER or UUID)
columns.product_id: Foreign key linking to products.product_id (INTEGER or UUID)
columns.quantity: Number of units of this product in the order (INTEGER)
columns.unit_price: Price per unit at the time of purchase in USD (NUMERIC). May differ from products.price if price changed.
columns.subtotal: Total value for this line item: quantity × unit_price (NUMERIC)

join_hints.full_chain: order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id

sample_questions: What are the top 5 products by total revenue?
How many units of each product were sold last quarter?
Which product category generates the most revenue?
